metadata.title: Non-concordant knots with the same trace
metadata.abstract: Miller and Piccirillo demonstrated the existence of non-concordant knots that share the same 0-trace. In this short note, we generalize their result by showing that every smooth concordance class contains a knot K such that, for every nonzero integer n, there exists a knot $K_n$ whose n-trace is orientation-preservingly diffeomorphic to that of K, but for which $p[K_n] \ne p[K]$ in the topological concordance group for every positive integer p. Furthermore, $p[K_n]$ is distinct from $p[K']$ for any knot K' obtained from K by mirroring and/or reversing its orientation.
